  {"operation":"etymology","chain":"Paris (from Gaulish) = pario- (to give birth, produce) + -is (locative); the cauldron or womb","reading":"The place of parturition, the womb or matrix","languages":["fr","la","cel"],"source":"Pokorny, Indogermanisches etymologisches Wörterbuch","confidence":0.65},
  {"operation":"phonetic_split","chain":"Pa + ris","reading":"The father (Pa) of the laugh (ris), the begetter through mockery","languages":["fr","la"],"source":"generative","confidence":0.75},
  {"operation":"phonetic_split","chain":"Par + is","reading":"Equal (par) to himself (is), the androgyne or self-sufficient one","languages":["fr","la"],"source":"generative","confidence":0.8},
  {"operation":"cross_language_homophone","chain":"Paris ≈ pari (Sanskrit, pair, couple) + is (Sanskrit, lord)","reading":"The lord of the pair, master of the androgyne","languages":["sa","fr"],"source":"generative","confidence":0.6},
  {"operation":"anagram","chain":"Paris = Sapir","reading":"The sapphire stone, the blue gem of the philosophers","languages":["fr","he"],"source":"generative","confidence":0.55},
  {"operation":"phonetic_split","chain":"Pâris = pas + ris","reading":"The step of the laugh, the dance that mocks death","languages":["fr"],"source":"generative","confidence":0.7},
  {"operation":"notariqon","chain":"P.A.R.I.S. = Pater Ad Rosam Ipsam Secretam","reading":"The Father to the Secret Rose itself","languages":["la","fr"],"source":"generative","confidence":0.5},
  {"operation":"letter_symbol","chain":"P (staff) + AR (eagle) + IS (Isis)","reading":"The staff of the eagle of Isis, the alchemical guide","languages":["fr","la","grc"],"source":"generative","confidence":0.45},
  {"operation":"etymology","chain":"Parisii (tribe name) from par (equal) + isi (from Isis)","reading":"The equals of Isis, her initiated people","languages":["la","fr"],"source":"Grasset d'Orcet, La Langue des Oiseaux","confidence":0.4},
  {"operation":"cross_language_homophone","chain":"Paris ≈ baris (Egyptian barge of the dead)","reading":"The funerary boat, the vessel that carries souls","languages":["grc","egy"],"source":"Plutarch via Fulcanelli tradition","confidence":0.55},
  {"operation":"phonetic_split","chain":"Par-is = père-hisse","reading":"The father that raises or lifts, the resurrector","languages":["fr"],"source":"generative","confidence":0.65},
  {"operation":"numerical","chain":"P=80 A=1 R=200 I=9 S=300 (gematria latine simplifiée)","reading":"The sum 590 = the measure of the perfect vessel","languages":["fr","he"],"source":"generative","confidence":0.35}
]
